documents.population: Applicants with a non-German university entrance qualification to undergraduate programmes
documents.notes: Freie Universität Berlin 'Application with Non-German University Entrance Qualification'. The VPD is applied for at uni-assist (year-round; valid one year), then the application is made in the FU application portal by 15 July (restricted programmes) or 1 September (unrestricted). Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): APS certificate (certificates from China, India or Vietnam), proof of sufficient German depending on the programme, documents for second-degree, teaching-degree, higher-semester and special requests.

items.quote: Upload all required documents to the application portal of Freie Universität Berlin, including your VPD, which you received from uni-assist.
valid VPD from uni-assist the VPD must be issued for Freie Universität Berlin.
all school leaving and university certificates which are part of your university entrance qualification

official translations of all certificates if issued in any language other than English or German issued either by a sworn translator or by an institution authorized to provide translations for official purposes
items.condition: certificates issued in a language other than English or German
